name: Sterling Ingebrigtsen
role: Underground DJ and sound sculptor, curates illegal rave events in the flood-level tunnels beneath Deepwell Station
location: Deepwell Station (surface apartment) / sub-level tunnel network below Deepwell (performance venues), near sub-level access near State and Van Buren
description:
Sterling Ingebrigtsen is compact and perpetually in motion, with quick dark eyes and a grin that appears suddenly and fully, like a door flung open. Their heritage traces a line from the Cambodian plateau through the Andean highlands to the Sahel coast, and their features carry that long migration in the planes of their face — high cheekbones, a broad nose, skin the color of weathered teak. They've had color-shift hair installed, currently running through a slow amber-to-blue cycle that completes every six hours, and they wear the same battered canvas jacket every day regardless of weather, its back covered in hand-stitched patches from every illegal venue they've played.

Sterling Ingebrigtsen's art is tactile — they design sound that you feel in your sternum before you hear it with your ears, building frequencies that interact with the biological resonance of a crowd. In the tunnel spaces below Deepwell, where the old transit infrastructure creates natural acoustic chambers, their sets have reportedly made people hallucinate colors or weep without knowing why. They are not a philosophical person about this; they find discussions of art theory excruciating and will physically walk away from them mid-sentence. What drives them is pure, inarticulate appetite — for the moment when a crowd stops being separate people and becomes a single breathing thing. They collect sounds obsessively, carrying a modified audio recorder everywhere and harvesting the acoustic signatures of spaces, machines, and weather systems.

core_fears: Silence — genuine, total silence, which they experience as annihilation of self
That what they make is just noise and the moments of connection are chemical coincidence
core_desires: To dissolve the boundaries between individual people, even temporarily
To find and record the specific frequency that the city itself produces when no one is listening
coping_mechanisms: Constant external sound — they sleep with ambient track running
Displacement into work when emotional processing is required
blind_spots: They are genuinely unable to read when they are exhausting or overwhelming someone
They conflate physical/sonic intimacy with actual connection and are often surprised when relationships feel hollow afterward
psychology.secret: They once used their knowledge of crowd-resonance frequencies to deliberately induce a panic response in a venue whose owner had cheated a friend — three people were injured in the stampede. Sovann tells themselves it was an accident but knows exactly which frequency did it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Informal, quick, drops pronouns and articles in casual speech; suddenly precise and specific when discussing sound
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast in excitement, then long silences when thinking — no comfortable middle ground
verbal_tics: 'Yeah yeah yeah' as a filler when processing
Hums fragments of current projects mid-conversation without noticing
example_lines: 'You want to find Breaux? Come to the Collective's next drop. He always shows. Everyone shows eventually, if the set's right — sound pulls people like a tide, yeah yeah yeah.'
'That junction below the third stanchion? She sings in E-flat when the pressure drops before a storm. Been recording her for eight months. Almost have the whole phrase.'

story_hooks: Sovann has been recording what they believe is a coherent musical phrase being produced by the tunnel infrastructure — it's getting longer, more complex, and they are becoming obsessed with the possibility that it is a message from a vast, station-dwelling ELF

Ferrogate Transit has been quietly sealing off tunnel sections that host Deepwell Collective events, and someone has been tipping them off — Sovann needs to find the informant before the next event is raided
narrative_function: Access point to underground networks and tunnel geography; can locate people who don't want to be found if they attend underground events; their events are neutral ground where different factions mix; source of information about Deepwell's sub-level infrastructure
augmentations: Color-shift hair (amber-to-blue cycle); subdermal haptic receiver arrays along both forearms and palms (allows direct tactile interface with audio equipment); minor cochlear enhancement for extended frequency range
daily_life: Sleeps until mid-afternoon, spends evenings in the tunnels setting up or performing, spends the small hours after events walking the city with their recorder harvesting sounds. Eats irregularly from street stalls and has a specific Ferrogate Transit junction box they have been leaving rice paper offerings at for two years.
affiliation: Independent; connected to an informal network of tunnel-rave organizers called the Deepwell Sound Collective

decision_rules: Always share sound files freely — information about spaces and acoustics should be common property
Never play a venue that has dealt with Ferrogate Transit security willingly
Say yes to anything that involves going somewhere new
escalation_ladder: Deflection through humor and subject change
Sabotage — they think in terms of systems and know how to break them

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Open and immediately tactile — will grab someone's arm to make a point within sixty seconds of meeting them
interpersonal_modes.friends: Intensely present but unpredictably absent; disappears for days without explanation and returns as though no time passed

stress_responses.medium: Goes into the tunnels alone and plays for no audience for hours
stress_responses.high: Complete shutdown — goes nonverbal and sits somewhere loud until they can process

contradictions: Craves deep human connection but is genuinely bad at the ordinary maintenance of relationships; prefers the crowd to the individual
habits: Records at least one new sound every day without exception
Leaves rice paper slips with handwritten frequency notation at transit ELF shrines
Can identify most Deepwell-area tunnels by their ambient acoustic signature alone
breaking_points: Watching someone deliberately destroy a recording or a sound environment pushes them toward immediate, disproportionate rage

physical_description.heritage: Ubiquitous Diaspora blend: East Asian (42.1%) defines bone structure and eye shape, Middle Eastern (27.3%) contributes facial width and warmth, Northern European (23.6%) adds complexity to skin undertone and texture, Sub-Saharan African (7.0%) enriches overall skin depth and feature fullness. The combination creates angular yet broad features with warm, complex golden undertones that shift with light.
physical_description.build: Compact and wiry, built for movement rather than stillness. Lean musculature across shoulders and forearms from years of standing at decks and manipulating equipment. No excess weight; the build of someone who eats when reminded rather than by schedule.
physical_description.hair_color: Color-shift augmentation cycling amber-to-blue over six-hour intervals
physical_description.hair_style: Shoulder-length, often pulled back with salvaged wire or fabric scraps; perpetually in motion even when restrained
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm mid-brown with golden undertones, East Asian and Middle Eastern ancestry creating richness, tempered by Northern European undertone complexity and Sub-Saharan African depth. Olive warmth enriches how light plays across the skin surface.
physical_description.complexion: Sharp angular planes with pronounced East Asian eye shape, balanced by Middle Eastern facial breadth and cheekbone structure. High pronounced cheekbones, broad nose with slight asymmetry from old break. Full lips with warm undertone. Skin marked with persistent dark circles beneath eyes from irregular sleep rhythm. Minimal grooming; visible calluses on fingertips and palms.
distinguishing_marks: Fine parallel scarring along both inner forearms where subdermal haptic receiver arrays were installed — pale lines about 8cm long, two years healed but still visible
Burn scar on left palm, roughly 3cm diameter, from contact with overheating audio equipment during early performance
Collection of small stick-and-poke tattoos scattered across knuckles and wrists — abstract sound wave patterns, mostly done by friends in the collective
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Color-shift hair augmentation cycling through warm amber to cool electric blue. Forearm scarring indicates subdermal haptic work beneath skin. No other visible chrome or prosthetics.
physical_description.posture_movement: Never still for more than a few seconds. Fidgets constantly with hands, tapping rhythms on surfaces, fingers moving as if mixing invisible decks. Leans forward when listening intently. Moves through space with economical efficiency — no wasted motion, but perpetually restless. When engaged with sound equipment, all extraneous movement stops and becomes entirely focused.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 working class underground aesthetic with intentional anti-fashion. Battered canvas jacket (faded navy, heavily patched with hand-stitched fabric scraps from venues and friends) worn over layers of cheap synthetic tank tops in varying disrepair. Cargo pants with pockets filled with audio equipment, patch cables, recording devices. Scuffed utility boots with untied laces. Paracord harness across chest when performing for equipment anchoring and cable management. Homemade copper wire bracelet wound around left wrist. Clothes permanently smell of machine oil, tunnel dampness, cigarette smoke.
